Built around the site.

For more than 50 years, Er-Con has brought technical analysis, proprietary systems and field execution together to protect critical assets in demanding environments.

The Er-Con approach

Treat the cause, not just the damage.

The visible erosion is only part of the problem. Water velocity, channel movement, unstable soils, bed degradation, hydraulic pressure and adjacent infrastructure all influence what will work.

Er-Con evaluates those conditions before recommending a solution. That site-specific approach helps avoid standard remedies applied to complex problems and creates a clearer path to durable performance, lower maintenance and reduced risk.

No two sites behave exactly the same.

Our work considers the life of the asset, hydraulic and geomorphic conditions, constructability, regulatory requirements, environmental impact and the realities of the field.

From first look to finished installation

Er-Con carries the solution through.

Each capability is internal, allowing technical decisions and field execution to stay connected throughout the project.

01

Site Evaluation

Document the field conditions, affected assets, site geometry, soils, banks and waterway characteristics.

02

Analysis

Identify the forces driving erosion, including hydraulic, geomorphic and sediment-related factors.

03

Engineering & Design

Evaluate alternatives and develop a site-specific solution built around performance and constructability.

04

Permitting

Prepare applications, coordinate with agencies and address environmental and regulatory requirements.

05

Fabrication

Produce project-specific systems and components that match the design and conditions in the field.

06

Installation & Monitoring

Deliver the work safely, adapt to field conditions and provide post-construction monitoring when requested.

Core erosion-control systems

The right system for the conditions.

Er-Con selects and configures each solution around the forces acting on the site and the asset that needs protection.

River Training

Palisade™

A patented system that redirects high-velocity and turbulent flow away from threatened banks while encouraging natural accretion and habitat recovery.

Bank Stabilization

Flexible Concrete Revetment™

A flexible, vented system designed for steep grades, head cuts and conditions where rigid structures may be vulnerable to movement or hydrostatic pressure.

Articulating Grout Mat

Ercoform™

Custom-fabricated, cable-reinforced concrete mattresses that conform to the site and resist bed degradation, bank erosion and erosive forces.

Explore Ercoform →

Revegetated Protection

Eco-Flex™

An open-cell articulating mat that supports natural vegetation while providing protection against periodic high-flow events.

Integrated Coverage

System 21™

A combined approach using Ercoform for high-strength bed protection and Eco-Flex along banks where revegetation is appropriate.

Exposed Infrastructure

Pipeline Supports

Standard and high-strength support systems for exposed or suspended pipelines where conventional cover is impractical or immediate stabilization is needed.

Additional capabilities

More than one way to stabilize a site.

Precast Articulating Block Mats

For lower-velocity applications where site access and equipment allow efficient placement.

Turf Reinforcement Matting

For moderate- and low-velocity flow conditions where reinforced vegetation can provide effective protection.

Grid-Reinforced Stabilization

High-tensile geogrid systems used within engineered fill to reconstruct and reinforce unstable slopes.
